##### Project general facts

Rise by Athlon is the first apartment collection within an active-living master community by Aldar, designed so that residents are never far from their next activity. Three low-rise buildings rise above a ground floor and a podium to four residential floors, while five themed towers reach between twenty-one and twenty-seven residential floors, creating a dynamic vertical expression of life in motion. Expressive lines, natural materials and lighting accents shape a contemporary silhouette, and the project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Amenities are designed for movement, wellness and social life. A state-of-the-art gym sits within a terraced podium that flows from the central park, connected to active wellness loops for walking, running and cycling. A rhythm room, a workshop, a game simulator, a recovery studio, a social fitness hub, a cinema, a mind and body library, a games hub and kids' playrooms sit alongside a family pool, plunge pool, splash area, skate park, pet park, yoga pavilion, meditation deck and outdoor training zones.

Interiors combine elegance and functionality, creating a cosy and stylish atmosphere for comfortable living. Bright living rooms open onto balconies, while closed kitchens and spacious master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms offer privacy and practicality. Stepped terraces and vertical gardens connect the buildings with the surrounding parkland, bringing greenery close to every home. Apartments are delivered fully furnished, allowing residents to move in and enjoy the active community lifestyle straight away.

##### Location description and benefits

Arabian Ranches is a collection of established family communities in Dubailand, set within one of the largest green spaces in Dubai and surrounded by desert landscapes, parks and golf courses. The area offers a calm suburban lifestyle with schools, nurseries, clinics, community centres and supermarkets, while desert trails and the nearby Al Qudra cycling track provide endless options for outdoor activity.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road and Al Qudra Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai International Airport, Jumeirah Beach, Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are within comfortable driving distance, while Global Village, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Miracle Garden and Arabian Ranches Golf Club are a short drive away from home, keeping leisure, shopping and dining close at hand.

Arabian Ranches is one of Dubai's most popular freehold destinations, with strong demand from families seeking space, greenery and a community lifestyle. Apartments within an active-living villa community offer an accessible entry point into an established area, supporting steady rental demand from young professionals and families. LEED-focused design and the backing of a leading developer underpin long-term value for owners and investors.
